basic_details.job_title: TNDALU Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Residential Matron & Residential Supervisor Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Tamil Nadu Dr. Ambedkar Law University (TNDALU) has notified 3 vacancies for Residential Matron for Girls Hostel and Residential Hostel Supervisor for girls Hostel posts on a contract basis for 11 months, with applications due on or before 3 November 2026. Eligible female Indian citizens can apply offline by sending their bio-data, passport-size photo, and one set of attested photocopies of all certificates to The Warden, The Tamil Nadu Dr. Ambedkar Law University, M.G.R. Salai, Perungudi Campus, Chennai. Qualifications required are 10th, 12th std or any Diploma courses for the Matron post
